tailoring.headline: Technical Lead - E-Commerce Platforms | Headless APIs, PWA & SAP Commerce Cloud | Middleware
tailoring.summary: Backend and e-commerce developer with 5+ years of experience delivering robust enterprise commerce solutions and middleware integrations across SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, OCC REST Web Services, headless commerce architectures, and PWA integrations. Hands-on with CCv2 cloud deployments, Solr search, and complex ERP/PIM integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer experienced in cross-functional technical leadership, code reviews, and agile delivery.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: React Technical Lead - Tryzens Global
cover_en.hook: Tryzens Global's reputation for engineering world-class digital commerce ecosystems across modern platforms and middleware makes this an exciting opportunity. Bringing 5+ years of dedicated enterprise e-commerce experience across SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer proven expertise in headless API design, PWA integrations, and core middleware services.

bullets.label: Headless Architecture & APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for modern headless storefronts and PWA frontends, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data delivery.

bullets.label: E-Commerce & Middleware Integration
bullets.text: Engineered resilient data pipelines and resolved critical integration bottlenecks between SAP Commerce, ERP, and MDM platforms working with global technical teams.

bullets.label: Technical Mentoring & Code Quality
bullets.text: Performed regular code reviews, provided technical guidance to junior developers, and maintained high platform stability across complex enterprise deployments.

bullets.label: Cloud & Production Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and led performance optimization to ensure high-speed transactional response.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my platform integration and technical leadership background can support Tryzens Global.

tailoring.why_company: Tryzens Global stands out for its deep multi-platform mastery across leading e-commerce technologies and robust middleware solutions. I want to contribute to an agency that prioritizes technical craftsmanship, innovative digital customer experiences, and end-to-end integration excellence for global retail brands.
tailoring.motivation_short: E-commerce specialist eager to bring 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud, OCC headless API, and middleware integration experience to Tryzens Global's high-performing delivery team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I noticed Tryzens Global is expanding its e-commerce engineering capacity. With 5+ years in enterprise SAP Commerce, headless OCC APIs, and middleware integrations at Rockwell and Shell, I would welcome the chance to connect regarding technical opportunities.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: React Technical Lead - Tryzens Global - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Technical Lead opening at Tryzens Global. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience delivering headless OCC APIs, SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, and complex middleware integrations for global brands including Rockwell Automation and Shell, I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical and integration background aligns with your team's goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
